description: A realistic `ffmpeg -encoders` listing: banner + flag legend before the ------ separator (all skipped), then entries whose 6-char [A-Z.] flags column precedes the encoder name. Video, audio, and subtitle rows all parse; the description column is ignored.
output:
Encoders:
 V..... = Video
 A..... = Audio
 S..... = Subtitle
 .F.... = Frame-level multithreading
 ..S... = Slice-level multithreading
 ...X.. = Codec is experimental
 ....B. = Supports draw_horiz_band
 .....D = Supports direct rendering method 1
 ------
 V....D a64multi             Multicolor charset for Commodore 64 (codec a64_multi)
 V..... libsvtav1            SVT-AV1(Scalable Video Technology for AV1) encoder (codec av1)
 V..... libvpx-vp9           libvpx VP9 (codec vp9)
 V....D libx264              libx264 H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10 (codec h264)
 V..... libx265              libx265 H.265 / HEVC (codec hevc)
 V...B. mpeg4                MPEG-4 part 2
 A....D aac                  AAC (Advanced Audio Coding)
 S..... srt                  SubRip subtitle
